newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Unibanco started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Unibanco started as buy.

text.p: -- Paribas Capital Markets, in association with Brazil's Banco BBA, said it has begun coverage of third-largest Brazilian bank Unibanco's preferred shares with a buy recommendation.
-- Paribas analyst Carlos Gomez-Lopez said the rating is based on the bank's conservative and "very focused" management over the last few years.
-- "They are the most conservative in the lending portfolio and have the best provisioned loan portfolio of any large Brazilian bank," he said.
-- He also cited the attractive terms of the bank's acquisition of Banco Nacional assets last year.
-- Gomez-Lopez further said Unibanco, which focuses on the retail market, is likely to be the first Brazilian bank to launch American Depositary Receipts.
-- Paribas also cited an improvement in the perception of systemic risk for Brazilian banks, adding most problems in the sector are publically known and many are on the way to being resolved.
-- It also cited the benefits of the low-inflation environment created by Brazilian's Real stabilization plan.
-- "Brazilian banks will enjoy rising profitability from growing volumes while lower provisions for loan losses will compensate for tighter interest margins," Paribas said in a report.
-- Unibanco's preferred shares were down 1.09 reais at 29.01 reais 1448 local/1648 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
